### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Clean energy, resilient infrastructure, space exploration: no engineering challenge will remain beyond our reach.

2. We see a future where engineering limits no longer dictate humanity’s possibilities. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem we face. We must make that future our priority.

3. We reject the idea that humanity’s hardest engineering problems are permanent. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve them all. We stand for building the intelligence that makes that breakthrough possible.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We mean every major problem: producing abundant clean energy, building infrastructure that withstands extreme conditions, delivering clean water, and making space exploration practical at an entirely new scale. We will no longer have to accept today’s technical limits as tomorrow’s boundaries. We see the creation of superintelligent AI as the decisive engineering breakthrough that unlocks all the others. Our task is to build it responsibly and ensure its solutions serve humanity. We are committed to that future, and we are ready to work for it.
